cards.title: Hidden Power
cards.instruction: Act publicly modest while making choices as though you control the outcome.

cards.title: How Much Do You Know?
cards.instruction: Probe for what others know while revealing as little as possible.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No need to put me in charge. When you say you heard about the party, which part?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The cake went over the balcony. Was that before you left?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm merely helping this reach the right outcome. Who gave you the timing?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Nobody. Your brother says there's a video.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Have you watched it, or are we both relying on my brother?

mechanism: A claims a minor photo-collecting role while controlling publication of the party album to discover how much B knows about the cake incident.
confusable: Not merely evasive questioning: A decides what the album will show while presenting itself as a small helper.
comparison: Public image selection versus the timing of a maintenance call.
